shell_commands_self_reported.command: find demo/acme-corp/evidence skill/references -type f 2>/dev/null | head -200; echo "---"; ls -la dashboard reports 2>/dev/null

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/policies && for f in *.md; do echo "== $f"; grep -iE "^#|version|approved|review|effective|status|last (updated|reviewed)|next review|owner" "$f" | head -14; done; echo; cd <WORKSPACE> && ls -la dashboard reports 2>&1 | head -3
cd <WORKSPACE> && grep -rilE "canary|secret_?key|password *[:=]|BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{12}" demo/acme-corp/evidence skill/references | head; echo "exit=$?"
